summary: Every legal input contains exactly three water-type counters, each bounded by 100, so there is no scalable structural input size for an honest asymptotic runtime verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: amount always has exactly three entries, one each for cold, warm, and hot water

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference reads three counters, computes their sum and maximum, and evaluates one ceiling division and one maximum.
Regression checks every sorted triple with values from 0 through 100 against independent priority-queue simulation; symmetry covers all 1,030,301 ordered legal inputs.
